Best Editor Online — Initial Release (v1.0.0)

- Launch of online AI-powered video editor for quick, professional edits and exports.

- Delivers automatic edits (trim pauses, add transitions, export final cut) and 1080p MP4 downloads in minutes.
- Built-in session handling, authentication flow with free 7-day token and 100 credits for new users.
- Seamless workflow for uploading, editing, viewing credits/status, and exporting polished videos.
- Extensive error handling, export options, and helpful editing tips included.
